errors.text_span: Both lines show a general upward trend
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate over-generalization. While the "Consistency" line shows a clear upward trend, the "Inconsistency" line is mostly flat with fluctuations, not showing a general upward trend (it starts at 25.0 and ends at ~25.9).

errors.text_span: with the "Consistency" line consistently achieving higher BLEU scores than the "Inconsistency" line across most of the prefix length range
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. The "Inconsistency" line has higher BLEU scores for prefix lengths from 0 to approximately 8. The "Consistency" line is only higher for the latter part of the range (from ~9 to 20), which is not "most of the prefix length range".
